method: Unmodified continuous original-ROM replay after whole-victory1021 snapshot,1076..1418 inclusive. Two original HUD bars identified by exact OAM tile/palette/position and excluded. All other scene OAM, mapped CHR, palette, flip, ordering and original per-scanline sprite-overflow masking retained. Every native-visible non-HUD opaque pixel inside JSNES default8pixel TV crop checked (export retains uncropped source edges) against emulator output. No backdrop/scenery/HUD baked into artwork.
limitations: Single controlled MM6 Tomahawk victory trace, not a full stage playthrough.
Timeline is original rendered updates replayed as active GMS updates, not a general ROM interpreter.
MM6 scripted pose replaces MM5 pose only during acquisition/teleport; gameplay position/collision stay locked at the real supported anchor.
No GMS GPU, scheduler or runtime acceptance.
